signal: role-level hypothesis: heads of telco sales face long carrier cycles and more accounts than the team can cover

email.subject1: telco pipeline left on the table
email.body1:
Brandon, running telco sales at Bolt, you're likely sitting on more carrier and operator accounts worth a conversation than the team can realistically touch each quarter.

That is the classic coverage gap in telecom: long cycles, big account lists, and reps buried in research instead of in conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Bolt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brandon, quick follow-up for Bolt.

In telco sales, most leaders can't say how many qualified meetings they need to feed a pipeline that converts over long carrier cycles, so the gap surfaces late and recovering the quarter gets expensive.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bolt needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brandon, last bit of proof for Bolt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bolt's reply rate likely compares to other B2B tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brandon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling telco pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Carrier cycles run long and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a telco sales motion? I'll tailor it to Bolt either way.
